sections.title: Lead-in — the weather and the seasons

exercises.instructionEn: In which card is the weather ...?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi kartada ob-havo ... ?
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — OB-HAVO.

Sarlavha: 'Come Rain or Shine'
  so'zma-so'z: yomg'ir yog'sa ham, quyosh chiqsa ham
  ma'nosi: har qanday sharoitda, nima bo'lsa ham
  o'zbekchada: 'Qanday bo'lmasin', 'Har holatda ham'

TO'RT KARTA:
  A — gullagan daraxt, pushti ko'ylakdagi ayol, yigit gul uzyapti
  B — qor, yalang'och daraxtlar, qorbo'ron o'ynayotgan bolalar
  C — plyaj, katta to'q sariq soyabon, cho'milish kiyimidagi odam
  D — kuchli shamol, yalang'och daraxtlar, ko'l bo'yida ketayotgan
      paltodagi odamlar

OB-HAVO SIFATLARI:
  cold ......... sovuq
  cloudy ....... bulutli
  windy ........ shamolli
  freezing cold  qattiq sovuq (muzlatadigan)
  snowy ........ qorli
  hot .......... issiq
  sunny ........ quyoshli
  warm ......... iliq

tasks.whyUz:
D kartada daraxtlar shamoldan egilgan, odamlar shlyapasini ushlab turibdi.
Osmon bulutli va kulrang — kuz ob-havosi.

B kartada hamma yer qor bilan qoplangan, bolalar qorbo'ron o'ynayapti.
'freezing' = muzlatadigan — 'very cold' dan kuchliroq.

C kartada plyaj, quyoshdan saqlanish uchun katta soyabon,
odamlar cho'milish kiyimida — demak JUDA ISSIQ.

A kartada daraxtlar gullagan, o't yashil, osmon ochiq.
Issiq emas — ILIQ (bahor).

exercises.instructionEn: Label the cards with the names of the seasons: summer, winter, spring or autumn.
exercises.instructionUz: Kartalarni fasl nomlari bilan belgilang: summer, winter, spring yoki autumn.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT FASL:
  spring ..... bahor  (mart, aprel, may)
  summer ..... yoz    (iyun, iyul, avgust)
  autumn ..... kuz    (sentabr, oktabr, noyabr)
              amerikacha: fall
  winter ..... qish   (dekabr, yanvar, fevral)

DIQQAT — FASL OLDIDA PREDLOG:
  IN spring, IN summer, IN autumn, IN winter
  Artikl kerak emas: 'in THE spring' ham to'g'ri, lekin
  kitob artiklsiz shaklni beradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: What's the weather like in spring?
  S2: It's warm and sunny in spring.

DIQQAT — 'What's the weather LIKE?':
  Bu ob-havo haqidagi ASOSIY savol.
  'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS — 'qanday?' degani.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Ob-havo nimaga o'xshaydi?'

JAVOB DOIM 'IT'S ...' bilan boshlanadi:
  It's warm.  It's raining.  It's cold and windy.
  DIQQAT: 'The weather is warm' ham to'g'ri, lekin
  'IT'S ...' tabiiyroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Match these sentences to the cards. Two of them do not match any of the cards.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni kartalarga moslang. Ulardan ikkitasi hech qaysi kartaga mos kelmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — IKKI GAP HECH QAYSI KARTAGA MOS KELMAYDI.
Kartalarda YOMG'IR ham, TUMAN ham yo'q.

OB-HAVO — IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:

  1) FE'L bilan (hozir sodir bo'layotgan hodisa):
       It is raining.   — yomg'ir yog'yapti
       It is snowing.   — qor yog'yapti
       The sun is shining. — quyosh charaqlayapti
       The wind is blowing. — shamol esayapti

  2) SIFAT bilan ('be' + sifat):
       It's rainy.   — yomg'irli
       It's snowy.   — qorli
       It's sunny.   — quyoshli
       It's windy.   — shamolli
       It's cloudy.  — bulutli
       It's foggy.   — tumanli

Sifatlar OT + -Y qoidasi bilan yasalgan:
  rain → rainy,  snow → snowy,  sun → sunny,
  wind → windy,  cloud → cloudy,  fog → foggy

tasks.prompt: 1  There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing. It's cloudy and windy.
tasks.promptUz: Shamolda egilgan daraxtlar bor kartani toping
tasks.whyUz:
D kartada daraxtlar shamoldan egilgan va osmon bulutli.
'a cloud' = bulut; 'to blow' = esmoq.
tasks.speak: 1  There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing. It's cloudy and windy.

tasks.prompt: 2  The sun is shining. It's sunny.
tasks.whyUz:
A karta (bahor) ham, C karta (yoz) ham quyoshli.
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri javob.
'to shine' = charaqlamoq, porlamoq.
tasks.speak: 2  The sun is shining. It's sunny.

tasks.prompt: 3  It is raining. It's a rainy day.
tasks.whyUz:
HECH QAYSI kartaga mos kelmaydi — birortasida ham yomg'ir yo'q.
Bu — kitob aytgan ikki gapdan biri.
tasks.speak: 3  It is raining. It's a rainy day.

tasks.prompt: 4  It is snowing. It's a snowy day.
tasks.whyUz: B kartada hamma yer qor bilan qoplangan.
tasks.speak: 4  It is snowing. It's a snowy day.

tasks.prompt: 5  There is a lot of fog. It's foggy.
tasks.whyUz:
HECH QAYSI kartaga mos kelmaydi — birortasida ham tuman yo'q.
'fog' = tuman (sanalmaydigan ot).
Bu — kitob aytgan ikki gapdan ikkinchisi.
tasks.speak: 5  There is a lot of fog. It's foggy.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the cards. Which card shows someone who is wearing: 1 a red coat? 2 gloves? 3 boots? 4 a pink dress? 5 a heavy jacket? 6 a blue hat? 7 a swimming-costume? 8 a jacket and a red tie? 9 a black cap?
exercises.instructionUz: Kartalarga qarang. Qaysi kartada kimdir quyidagini kiygan: 1 qizil palto? 2 qo'lqop? 3 etik? 4 pushti ko'ylak? 5 qalin kurtka? 6 ko'k shlyapa? 7 cho'milish kiyimi? 8 pidjak va qizil galstuk? 9 qora kepka?
exercises.explanationUz:
KIYIM SO'ZLARI:
  a coat ............. palto
  gloves ............. qo'lqoplar (doim ko'plikda)
  boots .............. etiklar (doim ko'plikda)
  a dress ............ ko'ylak (ayollar uchun)
  a jacket ........... kurtka, pidjak
  a hat .............. shlyapa
  a swimming-costume . cho'milish kiyimi
  a tie .............. galstuk
  a cap .............. kepka (kozirekli bosh kiyim)

DIQQAT — 'to wear' fe'li:
  Hozir kiyib turgan bo'lsa: someone IS WEARING ...
  'to wear' = kiyib yurmoq (holat)
  'to put on' = kiyib olmoq (harakat)

tasks.whyUz:
B kartada chapdagi kichkina qiz QIZIL palto kiygan.
DIQQAT: D kartadagi ayolning paltosi PUSHTI (pink), qizil emas.

B kartadagi qizning qo'lida oq qo'lqop bor.
'gloves' DOIM ko'plikda — ikkita qo'l uchun.

B kartadagi katta bolada qizil bog'ichli etiklar bor.
DIQQAT: A kartada ham etik bor, lekin B da qish etiklari aniqroq ko'rinadi.

A kartadagi ayol uzun PUSHTI ko'ylak kiygan.
'a dress' — faqat ayollar kiyimi.

D kartadagi yigit qalin, mo'ynali qora kurtka kiygan.
'heavy' bu yerda = qalin, issiq (og'ir emas).
DIQQAT: B kartadagi bolaning kurtkasi ham qalin.
B kartadagi qizil paltodagi qiz KO'K shlyapa kiygan.

C kartada qumda o'tirgan odam qizil cho'milish kiyimida.
'a swimming-costume' — britancha; amerikacha 'a swimsuit'.

tasks.prompt: 8  a jacket and a red tie?
tasks.whyUz: A kartadagi yigit to'q rangli pidjak va QIZIL galstuk kiygan.
tasks.speak: 8  a jacket and a red tie?

tasks.promptUz: Shamolda bosh kiyimini ushlab turgan yigit
tasks.whyUz:
D kartadagi yigitda qora kepka bor — shamol uni uchirib yubormasin deb ushlab turibdi.
DIQQAT: A kartadagi yigitning kepkasi KATAKLI (checked), qora emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: miss, keep, make, season's, heavy, decorate, enjoy

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  'to' dan keyin → FE'L (decorate, enjoy, make, keep)
  ot oldida      → SIFAT yoki EGALIK (heavy, season's)
  ega + ...      → FE'L (miss)

Barcha iboralar 49-betdagi uchta otkritkadan olingan.

tasks.whyUz:
'to decorate the Christmas tree' = archani bezamoq (B otkritka).
Gap: They are decorating the Christmas tree.

'We miss you a lot' = sizni juda sog'indik (B otkritka).
Ko'plik ega ('we') → fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.

'to enjoy the good weather' = yaxshi ob-havodan zavqlanmoq (C otkritka).
Gap: Everyone is enjoying the good weather.

'Season's greetings' = bayram tabriklari (C otkritka).
Egalik apostrofi: season + 's.

'heavy jackets' = qalin kurtkalar (A otkritka).
'heavy' bu yerda = qalin, issiq (og'ir emas).

'to make a snowman' = qorbobo yasamoq (A otkritka).
Gap: They are making a snowman in the park.

'to keep them warm' = ularni issiq saqlamoq (A otkritka).
Bu ibora 40-betdagi pingvin matnida ham bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in on, in, at, of or from.
exercises.instructionUz: on, in, at, of yoki from predloglarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR — ASOSIY QOIDALAR:

  IN — ichida: shahar, bog', xona, kiyim
       in Warsaw, in the park, in their pyjamas
  ON — yuzasida: plyaj, ko'cha, devor, muz
       on the beach, on the wall
  AT — aniq nuqta yoki vaqt:
       at the moment, at 5 o'clock, at home
  FROM — kelib chiqish nuqtasi:
       Greetings from London
  OF — egalik yoki tarkib:
       Lots of love, a lot of people

DIQQAT — SHAHAR va PLYAJ:
  IN Warsaw (shahar ICHIDA)
  ON the beach (plyaj YUZASIDA)

tasks.whyUz:
Shahar, mamlakat, mahalla → IN.
'It is cold IN Warsaw.'

Bog', o'rmon, xona → IN.
'They are making a snowman IN the park.'
'AT the moment' = ayni paytda — o'zgarmas ibora.
'Greetings FROM ...' = ...dan salom. Kelib chiqish nuqtasi → FROM.

'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.
'The children are IN their pyjamas.'

'ON the beach' — plyaj yuzasida turibdi → ON.
DIQQAT: 'in the beach' XATO.

'Lots OF love' = katta mehr bilan.
'lots of', 'a lot of' — miqdor iboralari doim OF bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at today's international weather chart. Symbols and temperature scale.
exercises.instructionUz: Bugungi xalqaro ob-havo jadvaliga qarang. Belgilar va harorat shkalasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
OB-HAVO BELGILARI (Symbols):
  bulut           = cloudy  (bulutli)
  puflab turgan bulut = windy (shamolli)
  bulut va tomchilar  = rainy (yomg'irli)
  quyosh          = sunny   (quyoshli)
  bulut va qor    = snowy   (qorli)

HARORAT SHKALASI (sovuqdan issiqqa):
  freezing cold  −5°C / 23°F   — qattiq sovuq
  cold            5°C / 41°F   — sovuq
  chilly         10°C / 50°F   — salqin (sovuqroq)
  cool           15°C / 59°F   — salqin (yoqimli)
  warm           25°C / 77°F   — iliq
  hot            30°C / 86°F   — issiq
  boiling hot    35°C / 95°F   — juda issiq

HARORAT BIRLIKLARI:
  °C = degrees Celsius   (Selsiy darajasi)
  °F = degrees Fahrenheit (Farengeyt darajasi)
  Britaniya va Yevropa °C, AQSH esa °F ishlatadi.

exercises.instructionUz: Bugungi xalqaro ob-havo jadvaliga qarang. Namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: What's the weather like in Cairo today?
  S2: It's warm and sunny.
  S1: What's the temperature in Cairo today?
  S2: It's 25°C. / It's 77°F.

IKKI SAVOL:
  What's the weather LIKE ...?  → sifat bilan javob
  What's the TEMPERATURE ...?   → daraja bilan javob

JADVAL:
  Cairo     quyosh  25 / 77
  London    shamol  10 / 50
  Madrid    bulut    5 / 41
  Manila    quyosh  30 / 86
  Paris     yomg'ir  5 / 41
  Prague    qor     −5 / 23
  Rome      bulut   15 / 59
  Singapore quyosh  35 / 95

tasks.whyUz: 10°C shkalada 'chilly' ga to'g'ri keladi; belgi shamolni bildiradi.
Jadvalda: London 10 C / 50 F.
5°C shkalada 'cold'; belgi oddiy bulut → cloudy.
Jadvalda: Madrid 5 C / 41 F.
30°C shkalada 'hot'; belgi quyosh → sunny.
Jadvalda: Manila 30 C / 86 F.
5°C shkalada 'cold'; belgi yomg'ir tomchilari → rainy.
Jadvalda: Paris 5 C / 41 F — Madrid bilan bir xil harorat, lekin ob-havo boshqa.

−5°C shkalada 'freezing cold'; belgi qor → snowy.
Bu — jadvaldagi eng sovuq shahar.

Jadvalda: Prague −5 C / 23 F.
Manfiy harorat: 'minus five degrees' deb o'qiladi.
15°C shkalada 'cool'; belgi oddiy bulut → cloudy.
Jadvalda: Rome 15 C / 59 F.

35°C shkalada 'boiling hot'; belgi quyosh → sunny.
Bu — jadvaldagi eng issiq shahar.
Jadvalda: Singapore 35 C / 95 F.

RO'YXAT: hat, shorts, tie, trousers, skirt, blouse

RASMDA YETTI ODAM VA ULARNING KIYIMI:

  PAUL   — to'q rangli KOSTYUM, ko'ylak va bo'yindagi a) ......
  STEVE  — qora jemper, katakli b) ...... , jigarrang tuflilar
  LUCY   — keng chetli c) ...... , uzun gulli ko'ylak, qizil etiklar
  JOHN   — charm kurtka, futbolka, charm d) ......
  DIANA  — oq e) ...... , kurtka, pushti f) ...... , qora paypoq-shim
  MARY   — ko'ylak, futbolka, jinsi shim, sandal
  JENNY  — kepka, futbolka, paypoq, krossovka

RASMDA ALLAQACHON YOZILGAN SO'ZLAR:
  shirt, suit, jumper, shoes, dress, boots, jacket,

BU MASHQ — BUTUN UNIT LUG'ATINING JAMLANMASI.

tasks.whyUz:
Pol kostyum va ko'ylak kiygan; bo'yniga GALSTUK taqqan.
'a tie' /taɪ/ = galstuk. 'a suit and tie' — rasmiy kiyim.

Stiv qora jemper va KATAKLI KALTA SHIM kiygan.
'shorts' — DOIM ko'plikda.

Lyusi keng chetli SHLYAPA kiygan.
'a hat' — chetli; 'a cap' — kozirekli (Jenni kiygan).

Jon charm kurtka va charm SHIM kiygan.
'trousers' — DOIM ko'plikda (britancha; amerikacha 'pants').

Diana oq BLUZKA va uning ustidan kurtka kiygan.
'a blouse' /blaʊz/ — faqat ayollar kiyimi.

Diana pushti YUBKA kiygan, ostidan qora paypoq-shim (tights).
'a skirt' — faqat pastki qism; 'a dress' — yaxlit ko'ylak.

TASVIRLASH QOLIPI:
  Ism + is wearing + kiyim1, kiyim2 and kiyim3.

ARTIKL QOIDASI:
  BIRLIK kiyim → 'a' bilan:  a hat, a dress, a jacket, a tie
  KO'PLIK kiyim → 'a' YO'Q:  shorts, trousers, jeans, boots,

SANASH TARTIBI:
  Odatda YUQORIDAN PASTGA: bosh kiyim → ustki → pastki → oyoq kiyim.
  Oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and', qolganida vergul.

tasks.promptUz: Oq bluzka, kurtka, pushti yubka, qora paypoq-shim
tasks.whyUz:
'tights' = paypoq-shim (kolgotki) — DOIM ko'plikda.
Qolganlari birlik → 'a' bilan.

tasks.answer: Mary is wearing a shirt, a T-shirt, jeans and sandals.
tasks.whyUz:
'jeans' va 'sandals' — KO'PLIK → 'a' YO'Q.
Meri stulda o'tirgan holda tasvirlangan.

tasks.answer: Jenny is wearing a cap, a T-shirt, socks and trainers.
tasks.whyUz:
'socks' va 'trainers' — KO'PLIK → 'a' YO'Q.
Jenni beysbol tayoqchasini ushlab turibdi.

exercises.instructionEn: GAME. Choose a student in your class and describe his/her clothes. The first person to guess who you are describing goes next.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN. Sinfingizdan bir o'quvchini tanlang va uning kiyimini tasvirlang. Kimni tasvirlayotganingizni birinchi topgan odam keyingi navbatni oladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN QOIDASI:
  1) Sinfdan bir kishini ichingizda tanlaysiz
  2) Uning kiyimini tasvirlaysiz (ISMINI aytmasdan!)
  3) Kim birinchi topsa, keyingi navbat unga o'tadi

QOLIP:
  He/She is wearing + kiyim1, kiyim2 and kiyim3.

DIQQAT: 'he' yoki 'she' dan boshlang — bu jinsni bildiradi,
lekin ismni oshkor qilmaydi.

tasks.en: S1: She is wearing a blue dress and black shoes.
tasks.uz: U ko'k ko'ylak va qora tufli kiygan.

tasks.en: S2: Is it Nilufar?
S1: Yes, it is. Your turn!
S2: He is wearing a white shirt, grey trousers and trainers.
tasks.uz: U oq ko'ylak, kulrang shim va krossovka kiygan.

S2: No, it isn't. Try again!

sections.title: Vocabulary — clothes and activities in the park

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and use the words in the two lists below to say what the people are wearing and what they are doing, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va quyidagi ikki ro'yxatdagi so'zlardan foydalanib, odamlar nima kiyganini va nima qilayotganini ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-RO'YXAT — KIYIM (13 ta):
  T-shirt ..... futbolka        shorts ..... kalta shim
  shirt ....... ko'ylak (erkak)  blouse ..... bluzka (ayol)
  skirt ....... yubka           jeans ...... jinsi shim
  dress ....... ko'ylak (ayol)  trousers ... shim
  jean shirt .. jinsi ko'ylak   cap ........ kepka
  trainers .... krossovka       hat ........ shlyapa
  a jacket .... kurtka, pidjak

2-RO'YXAT — MASHG'ULOT (8 ta):
  climb/a tree ...... daraxtga chiqmoq
  eat/a sandwich .... sendvich yemoq
  ride/a bicycle .... velosiped haydamoq
  pick/flowers ...... gul termoq
  drink/a Coke ...... kola ichmoq
  take/photographs .. suratga olmoq
  read/a book ....... kitob o'qimoq
  listen to music ... musiqa tinglamoq

RASMDAGI 8 ODAM:
  Barry   — daraxtga tirmashib chiqayapti (o'ngda)
  Linda   — engashib gul terayapti
  Tony    — velosipedda ketayapti
  Amanda  — fotoapparat bilan suratga olayapti
  Anne    — sendvich yeyayapti
  Ryan    — banka bilan kola ichayapti
  Stanley — shlyapali, ko'zoynakli chol, kitob o'qiyapti
  Mavis   — Stenlining yonida o'tirib, quloqchinda musiqa tinglayapti

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Barry is wearing a T-shirt and shorts. He is climbing a tree.

QOLIP (ikki gap):
  1) Ism + is wearing + kiyim.
  2) He/She + is + fe'l-ING + to'ldiruvchi.

tasks.prompt: 2  What is Linda wearing? What is she doing?
tasks.answer: Linda is wearing a dress and trainers. She is picking flowers.
tasks.promptUz: U engashib, qo'lida gul dastasi bor
tasks.whyUz:
Linda engashib gul terayapti — qo'lida gul dastasi ko'rinadi.
'pick' → 'picking'. 'trainers' = krossovka (doim ko'plikda).
tasks.speak: 2  What is Linda wearing? What is she doing?

tasks.prompt: 3  What is Anne wearing? What is she doing?
tasks.answer: Anne is wearing a jean shirt and trousers. She is eating a sandwich.
tasks.promptUz: Uzun jinsi ko'ylakda, qo'lini og'ziga olib borgan
tasks.whyUz:
Anne uzun jinsi ko'ylak (cho'ntakli) va och rangli shim kiygan.
Ikki qo'li bilan sendvich ushlab yeyayapti.
'eat' → 'eating' (oddiy -ing).
tasks.speak: 3  What is Anne wearing? What is she doing?

tasks.prompt: 4  What is Ryan wearing? What is he doing?
tasks.answer: Ryan is wearing a shirt and jeans. He is drinking a Coke.
tasks.promptUz: Qo'lida banka bor, uni og'ziga olib borayapti
tasks.whyUz:
Rayan yoqali ko'ylak va kamarli shim kiygan.
Qo'lida kola bankasi — ichayapti.
'drink' → 'drinking'. 'a Coke' — bosh harf bilan (marka nomi).
tasks.speak: 4  What is Ryan wearing? What is he doing?

tasks.prompt: 5  What is Amanda wearing? What is she doing?
tasks.answer: Amanda is wearing a blouse and a skirt. She is taking photographs.
tasks.whyUz:
Amanda yoqali oq bluzka va kamarli yubka kiygan.
Fotoapparat bilan suratga olayapti.
'take photographs' = suratga olmoq → 'taking photographs' (-e TUSHDI).
tasks.speak: 5  What is Amanda wearing? What is she doing?

tasks.prompt: 6  What is Tony wearing? What is he doing?
tasks.answer: Tony is wearing a cap. He is riding a bicycle.
tasks.whyUz:
Toni kepka kiygan va velosiped haydayapti.
'ride' → 'riding' (-e TUSHDI).
'a cap' — kozirekli bosh kiyim; 'a hat' — chetli shlyapa.
tasks.speak: 6  What is Tony wearing? What is he doing?

tasks.prompt: 7  What is Stanley wearing? What is he doing?
tasks.answer: Stanley is wearing a hat. He is reading a book.
tasks.promptUz: Chetli shlyapa va ko'zoynakli keksa erkak
tasks.whyUz:
Stenli chetli shlyapa kiygan, ko'zoynak taqqan va kitob o'qiyapti.
'read' → 'reading' (oddiy -ing).
tasks.speak: 7  What is Stanley wearing? What is he doing?

tasks.prompt: 8  What is Mavis wearing? What is she doing?
tasks.answer: Mavis is wearing a jacket. She is listening to music.
tasks.whyUz:
Mavis to'q rangli kurtka kiygan va quloqchinda musiqa tinglayapti.
'listen TO music' — 'to' predlogi SHART.
'listen' → 'listening' (undosh IKKILANMAYDI — urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda).
tasks.speak: 8  What is Mavis wearing? What is she doing?

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
YANGI KIYIM SO'ZLARI:
  socks ..... paypoqlar (doim ko'plikda)
  sandals ... sandal, ochiq oyoq kiyim (doim ko'plikda)
  pyjamas ... pijama (doim ko'plikda)
  a coat .... palto

Har bir savolda GAP MA'NOSIGA qarang:
  qo'l uchun → qo'lqop
  oyoq uchun → oyoq kiyim
  uyquda    → pijama
  sovuqda   → palto

tasks.prompt: 1  We wear ............ to keep our hands warm.
tasks.promptUz: Biz qo'limizni issiq saqlash uchun ... kiyamiz.
tasks.whyUz:
'hands' (qo'llar) → GLOVES (qo'lqoplar).
'socks' = paypoq (oyoq uchun); 'shorts' = kalta shim.

tasks.prompt: 2  On the beach, people wear ............ on their feet.
tasks.whyUz:
Plyaj — issiq va qumli → SANDALS (ochiq oyoq kiyim).
'boots' (etik) issiqda noqulay; 'hats' (shlyapa) — bosh kiyim.

'in bed' = karavotda, uxlaganda → PYJAMAS (pijama).
DIQQAT: 'pyjamas' DOIM ko'plikda.

tasks.prompt: 4  When it's cold, I wear my ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
Sovuqda issiq ustki kiyim kerak → COAT (palto).
'swimming-costume' — issiq havoda; 'blouse' — yengil bluzka.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR BANDDA IKKI USUL BIRGA KELADI:
  1) FE'L bilan  — It's snowing.
  2) SIFAT bilan — It's a snowy day.

OB-HAVO BELGILARI (rasmda):
  qor tushayotgan bulut  → snowing / snowy
  puflab turgan bulut    → the wind is blowing / windy
  bulutlar               → there are clouds / cloudy
  quyosh                 → the sun is shining / sunny
  tomchili bulut         → raining / rainy

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1-bandning birinchi so'zi — 'snowing'.

DIQQAT — SIFAT YASALISHI:
  snow → snowy,  wind → windy,  cloud → cloudy,
  sun → sunny ('n' ikkilanadi),  rain → rainy

tasks.whyUz:
snow + -y = SNOWY (qorli).
'a snowy day' = qorli kun.

'The wind is blowing' = shamol esayapti.
'to blow' → 'blowing' (oddiy -ing).
wind + -y = WINDY (shamolli).

tasks.prompt: 3  There are [bulut belgisi] ............ in the sky.
tasks.whyUz:
'There ARE ...' → KO'PLIK kerak: CLOUDS (bulutlar).
'the sky' = osmon.
tasks.speak: 3  There are [bulut belgisi] ............ in the sky.

tasks.whyUz: cloud + -y = CLOUDY (bulutli).

tasks.promptUz: Osmondagi yorug'lik manbai va uning harakati
tasks.whyUz:
'The SUN is SHINING' = quyosh charaqlayapti.
'shine' → 'shining' (-e TUSHDI).
DIQQAT: 'the sun' — DOIM 'the' bilan (yagona narsa).

tasks.promptUz: Osmondagi yorug'lik manbai va uning harakati
tasks.whyUz:
'The SUN is SHINING' = quyosh charaqlayapti.
'shine' → 'shining' (-e TUSHDI).
DIQQAT: 'the sun' — DOIM 'the' bilan (yagona narsa).
sun + -y = SUNNY. Diqqat: 'n' IKKILANADI.

'It's raining' = yomg'ir yog'yapti.
'rain' → 'raining' (oddiy -ing).
rain + -y = RAINY (yomg'irli).

exercises.instructionEn: Now answer these questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi bu savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU SAVOLLAR SHAXSIY — javob har kimda har xil bo'ladi.
Quyida namuna javoblar berilgan (O'zbekiston uchun).

FOYDALI QOLIPLAR:
  It's + sifat (+ and + sifat) + today.
  It's + fasl (now).
  My favourite season is + fasl.
  I like + fasl + because ...
  I love/like + fe'l-ING

tasks.en: It's warm and sunny today.
tasks.note:
NAMUNA javob. O'z ob-havongizga qarab o'zgartiring:
  It's cold and cloudy today.
  It's raining today.
  It's hot today.

tasks.en: It's summer now.
tasks.note:
NAMUNA javob. Fasl nomi kichik harf bilan yoziladi:
spring, summer, autumn, winter.

tasks.en: My favourite season is spring.
tasks.note:
NAMUNA javob. Boshqa qolip: 'I like spring the best.'
'favourite' — britancha yozilishi.

tasks.en: I like spring because the weather is warm and everything is green. I love going for walks in the park.
tasks.note:
NAMUNA javob. Sabab DOIM 'because' bilan.
'like/love + fe'l-ING' — yoqtirish fe'llaridan keyin -ing.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard A (from Tom in Warsaw).
exercises.instructionUz: A otkritkasini o'qing (Varshavadagi Tomdan).
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA (a postcard) TUZILISHI:

  1) Murojaat:     Dear Sally,
  2) Salomlashish: A Happy New Year to all of you.
  3) Asosiy qism:  ob-havo, kiyim, mashg'ulot
  4) Yakun:        Hope to see you soon.
  5) Xayrlashuv:   Best wishes,
  6) Imzo:         Tom

MANZIL (o'ng tomonda):
  Sally Jones          — ism
  12 Swan St           — ko'cha va uy raqami
  London SW1 4GB       — shahar va pochta indeksi
  England              — mamlakat

DIQQAT: inglizcha manzil KICHIKDAN KATTAGA yoziladi
(ism → ko'cha → shahar → mamlakat).

tasks.en: Dear Sally,
tasks.note:
'Dear + ism' — xat va otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
O'zbekchadagidek 'Assalomu alaykum' emas.

tasks.en: A Happy New Year to all of you.
tasks.note:
'A Happy New Year to you' — tabrik shakli.
'all of you' = hammangiz.

tasks.en: You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw!
tasks.uz: Varshavada qanchalik sovuq ekanini tasavvur ham qila olmaysiz!
tasks.note:
'to imagine' = tasavvur qilmoq.
'how cold it is' — bilvosita gapda tartib O'ZGARMAYDI:
'how cold IS it' XATO.

tasks.en: It is snowing heavily today, so the children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves to keep them warm.
tasks.uz: Bugun qor qalin yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar issiq turish uchun qalin kurtka va qo'lqop kiyib olishgan.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'so' = shuning uchun (sabab-natija).
'to keep them warm' — 40-betdagi pingvin matnidagi ibora.

tasks.en: They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.
tasks.note:
'a snowman' = qorbobo (snow + man).
'at the moment' = ayni paytda — Present Continuous belgisi.

tasks.en: Hope to see you soon.
tasks.note: '(I) hope to see you soon' — ega tushirilgan, otkritkada odatiy.

tasks.en: Best wishes, Tom
tasks.note: 'Best wishes' — do'st va tanishlarga yoziladigan xayrlashuv.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard B (from Tracy in London).
exercises.instructionUz: B otkritkasini o'qing (Londondagi Treysidan).
exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL:
  Mr & Mrs Johnson   — janob va xonim Jonson
  2 Via Torino       — ko'cha (italyancha nom)
  Rome               — Rim
  Italy              — Italiya

Demak, Treysi Londondan Rimdagi ota-onasiga yozyapti.

DIQQAT: 'Mr' (janob) va 'Mrs' (turmush qurgan xonim) —
dan keyin nuqta qo'yilmaydi (britancha).

tasks.en: Dear Mum and Dad,
tasks.note: Ota-onaga murojaat. Britanchada 'Mum', amerikachada 'Mom'.

tasks.en: Greetings from London.
tasks.note:
'Greetings from ...' — otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
'a greeting' = salom, tabrik.

tasks.en: It's windy today and it is raining.
tasks.note: Ikki usul birga: SIFAT ('windy') va FE'L ('is raining').

tasks.en: The children are in their pyjamas in the living-room.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'pyjamas' DOIM ko'plikda (shim + ko'ylak).
'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.

tasks.en: They are very happy as they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment.
tasks.uz: Ular juda xursand, chunki hozir Rojdestvo archasini bezashayapti.
tasks.note:
'as' bu yerda = 'because' (chunki).
'to decorate' = bezamoq.
'the Christmas tree' = Rojdestvo archasi (yangi yil archasi).

tasks.en: We miss you a lot.
tasks.note:
'to miss somebody' = sog'inmoq.
'a lot' = juda ko'p (gap oxirida).

tasks.en: Love, Tracy
tasks.note:
'Love' — YAQIN kishilarga (oila, do'st) yoziladigan xayrlashuv.
Rasmiy xatda ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard C (from Pamela in Sydney).
exercises.instructionUz: C otkritkasini o'qing (Sidneydagi Pameladan).
exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL:
  Mrs Bessie Bates   — Bessi Beyts xonim
  27 Park Lane       — ko'cha
  London SW3 9RY     — shahar va indeks
  England            — mamlakat

QIZIQ FAKT — UCHALA OTKRITKA HAM YANGI YIL PAYTIDA YOZILGAN:
  Tom (Varshava)  — 'A Happy New Year'  → QOR
  Tracy (London)  — 'Christmas tree'    → YOMG'IR
  Pamela (Sidney) — 'Season's greetings' → PLYAJ, ISSIQ

SABABI: Avstraliya JANUBIY yarim sharda joylashgan —
u yerda dekabr YOZ oyi! Fasllar teskari bo'ladi.

tasks.en: Dear Aunt Bessie,
tasks.note: 'Aunt' = xola, amma, ammaki. Ism oldida BOSH harf bilan.

tasks.en: Season's greetings from Sydney.
tasks.note:
'Season's greetings' — Rojdestvo va Yangi yil tabrigi.
So'zma-so'z: 'faslning salomlari'.

tasks.en: The weather is fantastic today and we are on the beach.
tasks.uz: Bugun ob-havo ajoyib va biz plyajdamiz.
tasks.note:
'fantastic' = ajoyib, zo'r.
'ON the beach' — plyaj yuzasida → ON.

tasks.en: It's very hot and the sun is shining, so we are all in our swimming costumes.
tasks.uz: Juda issiq va quyosh charaqlayapti, shuning uchun hammamiz cho'milish kiyimidamiz.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'so' = shuning uchun.
'we are all' = hammamiz (all egadan KEYIN).

tasks.en: Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle.
tasks.uz: Oyim, dadam, Sheyla va Frenk qumdan qal'a yasashayapti.
tasks.note:
'a sandcastle' = qum qal'a (sand + castle).
Sanashda oxirgisidan oldin 'and'.

tasks.en: There are a lot of people on the beach today.
tasks.uz: Bugun plyajda juda ko'p odam bor.
tasks.note:
'people' — ko'plik ot → ARE.
'a lot of' = juda ko'p.

tasks.en: Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.
tasks.uz: Hamma suzyapti va yaxshi ob-havodan zavqlanayapti.
tasks.note:
'everyone' — shakli birlik → IS ('everyone are' XATO).
'to enjoy' = zavqlanmoq, huzur qilmoq.

tasks.en: Come and see us soon!
tasks.note:
Buyruq gap — taklif ma'nosida.
'come and + fe'l' = kelib ...moq.

tasks.en: Lots of love, Pamela
tasks.note: 'Lots of love' — 'Love' ning kuchliroq shakli, oila a'zolariga.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the sentences which describe the people's clothes in each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir rasmda odamlarning kiyimini tasvirlaydigan gaplar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir otkritkada KIYIM haqida BITTA gap bor.
Shu gaplarni topish kerak.

KIYIM HAQIDA GAPIRISHNING IKKI USULI:
  1) to WEAR + kiyim:  They are wearing heavy jackets.
  2) to BE IN + kiyim: They are in their pyjamas.
  Ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noda.

tasks.answer: The children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves to keep them warm.
tasks.whyUz: Qorli va sovuq ob-havoga mos kiyim: qalin kurtka va qo'lqop.

tasks.answer: The children are in their pyjamas in the living-room.
tasks.whyUz:
Uy ichida bo'lgani uchun pijamada.
'be IN + kiyim' — 'wear' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

tasks.answer: We are all in our swimming costumes.
tasks.whyUz: Issiq va plyajda bo'lgani uchun cho'milish kiyimida.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni otkritkalardan toping.
2, 3, 4-savollar 'What are ... doing?' shaklida —
demak javob ham Present Continuous bo'ladi.

tasks.prompt: 1  What is the weather like in Warsaw?
tasks.answer: It is very cold and it is snowing heavily.
tasks.whyUz: Tom: 'You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw! It is snowing heavily today.'
tasks.speak: 1  What is the weather like in Warsaw?

tasks.prompt: 1  What is the weather like in London?
tasks.answer: It's windy and it is raining.
tasks.whyUz: Treysi: 'It's windy today and it is raining.'
tasks.speak: 1  What is the weather like in London?

tasks.prompt: 1  What is the weather like in Sydney?
tasks.answer: It's very hot and the sun is shining.
tasks.whyUz:
Pamela: 'It's very hot and the sun is shining.'
Ob-havo 'fantastic' (ajoyib) deb ham baholangan.
tasks.speak: 1  What is the weather like in Sydney?

tasks.answer: They are making a snowman in the park.
tasks.promptUz: A otkritka, qor bilan nima qilinadi?
tasks.whyUz: Tom: 'They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.'

tasks.answer: They are decorating the Christmas tree.
tasks.whyUz: Treysi: 'they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment'.

tasks.answer: They are making a sandcastle. Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.
tasks.whyUz:
Pamela: 'Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle' va
'Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.'

sections.title: Reading & Listening — seasons around the world
sections.titleUz: O'qish va tinglash — dunyo mamlakatlaridagi fasllar

exercises.instructionEn: Read text A (Karen, Britain).
exercises.instructionUz: A matnini o'qing (Karen, Britaniya).
exercises.explanationUz:
A MATNI — BRITANIYA (Karen)

2-RASM: somon tomli eski inglizcha uy, atrofida gullar va
yashil o't — bahor manzarasi.

BRITANIYA IQLIMI:
  yil bo'yi — ko'p yomg'ir
  qish      — juda sovuq va shamolli
  kuz, bahor — ancha shamolli, lekin juda sovuq emas
  yoz       — ancha iliq, lekin bulutli ham bo'lishi mumkin

tasks.en: In Britain the weather is often rainy, but in winter it's also very cold and windy.
tasks.uz: Britaniyada ob-havo ko'pincha yomg'irli, lekin qishda juda sovuq va shamolli ham bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'often' = ko'pincha (chastota ravishi).
'also' = ham, shuningdek.

tasks.en: In autumn and spring it can be quite windy but it's not very cold.
tasks.uz: Kuz va bahorda ancha shamolli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin juda sovuq emas.
tasks.note:
'can be' = bo'lishi mumkin (ehtimollik).
'quite' = ancha (44-betdagi daraja so'zi).

tasks.en: Summer can be quite warm but it can also be cloudy.
tasks.uz: Yoz ancha iliq bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bulutli ham bo'lishi mumkin.
tasks.note: 'but' — ikki qarama-qarshi fikrni bog'laydi.

tasks.en: I like spring a lot because the trees are green and there are lots of flowers.
tasks.uz: Menga bahor juda yoqadi, chunki daraxtlar yashil va gullar ko'p bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
SEVIMLI FASL VA SABABI.
'a lot' = juda (fe'ldan keyin).
'lots of' = ko'p.

tasks.en: I often go for walks in the park, then.
tasks.uz: Shunda men ko'pincha bog'da sayr qilaman.
tasks.note:
'go for a walk' = sayrga chiqmoq (ko'plikda: go for walks).
'then' bu yerda = o'sha paytda, o'shanda.

exercises.instructionEn: Read text B (Miguel, Brazil).
exercises.instructionUz: B matnini o'qing (Migel, Braziliya).
exercises.explanationUz:
B MATNI — BRAZILIYA (Migel)

1-RASM: tog' va shahar fonidagi plyaj, ko'p odam —
Rio-de-Janeyro (Braziliya).

BRAZILIYA IQLIMI:
  umumiy   — iliq iqlim
  qish     — juda sovuq emas
  bahor, kuz — iliq, lekin yomg'irli
  yoz      — deyarli doim issiq va quyoshli

DIQQAT: Braziliya JANUBIY yarim sharda — fasllar
Britaniyanikiga TESKARI.

tasks.en: Brazil has a warm climate.
tasks.note:
'a climate' = iqlim (uzoq muddatli ob-havo).
'weather' esa — bugungi ob-havo. Farqiga e'tibor bering.

tasks.en: The winter isn't very cold.
tasks.note: Fasl oldida THE ishlatilishi ham mumkin: 'the winter'.

tasks.en: In spring and autumn it is warm, but rainy.
tasks.uz: Bahor va kuzda iliq, lekin yomg'irli bo'ladi.
tasks.note: Fasllar oldida IN predlogi.

tasks.en: In summer it's nearly always hot and sunny.
tasks.uz: Yozda deyarli doim issiq va quyoshli bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'nearly always' = deyarli doim.
'nearly' = deyarli.

tasks.en: Sometimes, it rains suddenly and then the sun comes out again!
tasks.uz: Ba'zan to'satdan yomg'ir yog'adi, so'ng quyosh yana chiqadi!
tasks.note:
'suddenly' = to'satdan (sudden + -ly).
'the sun comes out' = quyosh chiqadi (frazali fe'l).

tasks.en: Summer is my favourite season.
tasks.note:
SEVIMLI FASL.
'favourite' — britancha yozilishi (amerikacha: favorite).

tasks.en: I love swimming and sunbathing at the beach.
tasks.uz: Men plyajda suzish va quyoshda toblanishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.
tasks.note:
SABABI.
'love/like + fe'l-ING' — yoqtirish fe'llaridan keyin -ing keladi.

tasks.en: We have lots of fun there.
tasks.uz: Biz u yerda juda ko'p zavqlanamiz.
tasks.note:
'have fun' = zavqlanmoq, ko'ngil ochmoq.
'fun' sanalmaydigan ot → 'lots of fun'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read text C (Anita, Finland).
exercises.instructionUz: C matnini o'qing (Anita, Finlandiya).
exercises.explanationUz:
C MATNI — FINLANDIYA (Anita)

3-RASM: qorli o'rmon, yog'och uy va chang'i uchayotgan
odamlar — qish manzarasi.

FINLANDIYA IQLIMI:
  qish  — juda sovuq va JUDA UZUN;
          quyosh umuman chiqmaydigan kunlar bor
  yoz   — juda iliq, lekin KALTA;
          kunlar juda uzun, quyosh kechayu kunduz charaqlaydi

QIZIQ FAKT: Finlandiya Shimoliy qutbga yaqin.
Yozda 'oq tunlar' bo'ladi — quyosh botmaydi.
Qishda esa 'qutb tuni' — quyosh chiqmaydi.

tasks.en: In Finland the weather is very cold in the winter and very warm in the summer.
tasks.uz: Finlandiyada qishda ob-havo juda sovuq, yozda esa juda iliq bo'ladi.
tasks.note: Fasl oldida 'in THE winter' — 'in winter' ham to'g'ri.

tasks.en: The winter is very long and there are days when the sun doesn't appear at all.
tasks.uz: Qish juda uzun va quyosh umuman chiqmaydigan kunlar bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq, paydo bo'lmoq.
'not ... at all' = umuman ...emas (kuchli inkor).

tasks.en: The summer is short, but it's warm, because the days are so long.
tasks.uz: Yoz kalta, lekin iliq, chunki kunlar juda uzun.
tasks.note:
'so' bu yerda = juda ('very' bilan bir xil).
'because' — sabab bog'lovchisi.

tasks.en: The sun shines all day and night for most of the summer.
tasks.uz: Yozning ko'p qismida quyosh kechayu kunduz charaqlaydi.
tasks.note:
'all day and night' = kechayu kunduz.
'most of' = ko'p qismi.

tasks.en: I like winter the best because there is always snow and I often go skiing.
tasks.uz: Menga qish eng ko'p yoqadi, chunki doim qor bo'ladi va men ko'pincha chang'i uchgani boraman.
tasks.note:
SEVIMLI FASL VA SABABI.
'like ... the best' = eng ko'p yoqtirmoq.
'go skiing' = chang'i uchgani bormoq ('ski' → 'skiing', ikkita i).

exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni o'qing va har bir odam qaysi faslni eng ko'p yoqtirishini hamda nima uchun ekanini ayting. Nihoyat, o'z mamlakatingizdagi fasllar haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:

  I like spring A LOT because ...
  Summer is MY FAVOURITE SEASON. I love ...

SABAB DOIM 'because' bilan beriladi.

tasks.note: Migel: 'Summer is my favourite season.'

We have lots of fun there.'

tasks.note:
O'zbekistonda yoz juda issiq va quruq.
'hardly ever' = deyarli hech qachon.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the telephone conversation.
exercises.instructionUz: Telefondagi suhbatni o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QAHRAMON:
  Ian  — uyda, Angliyada
  Paul — Yamaykada ta'tilda, xotini Sonia bilan

TELEFON SUHBATI IBORALARI:
  Hello?              — Alo? (qo'ng'iroqni olganda)
  Hi ..., it's ...    — Salom ..., bu ...
  How are you?        — Qalaysiz?
  Where are you phoning from? — Qayerdan qo'ng'iroq qilyapsiz?

tasks.en: Ian: Hello?
tasks.note: Telefonda qo'ng'iroqni olgan odam shunday deydi (so'roq ohangi bilan).

tasks.en: Paul: Hi Ian, it's Paul.
tasks.note:
Telefonda o'zini tanishtirish: 'it's + ism'.
'I am Paul' — telefonda ISHLATILMAYDI.

tasks.en: Ian: Paul! How are you? How's Sonia?
tasks.note: 'How's' = How is. Ahvol so'rash.

tasks.en: Paul: Fine, we're both very well. You can't imagine how lovely it is here in Jamaica.
tasks.uz: Pol: Yaxshi, ikkalamiz ham juda yaxshimiz. Bu yerda, Yamaykada qanchalik go'zal ekanini tasavvur ham qila olmaysan.
tasks.note:
'both' = ikkalasi ham.
'how lovely it is' — bilvosita gapda tartib ODDIY qoladi.
Jamaica — Karib dengizidagi orol-davlat.

tasks.en: Ian: What's the weather like?
tasks.note: Ob-havo haqidagi ASOSIY savol (Coursebook 48-bet).

tasks.en: Paul: It's very hot and the sun's shining.
tasks.uz: Pol: Juda issiq va quyosh charaqlayapti.
tasks.note: 'the sun's shining' = the sun IS shining (qisqartma).

tasks.en: Ian: Where's Sonia? Is she with you?
tasks.uz: Ian: Sonia qayerda? U sen bilanmi?
tasks.note: 'Where's' = Where is.

tasks.en: Paul: Sonia is sunbathing in her swimming costume near the pool.
tasks.uz: Pol: Sonia hovuz yonida cho'milish kiyimida quyoshda toblanayapti.
tasks.note:
'near the pool' = hovuz yonida.
'IN her swimming costume' — kiyim uchun IN.

tasks.en: Ian: And where are you phoning from?
tasks.note:
'phone from' — 'from' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
'to phone' = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

tasks.en: Paul: At the moment, I'm sitting on the balcony of our hotel room.
tasks.uz: Pol: Ayni paytda men mehmonxona xonamizning balkonida o'tiribman.
tasks.note:
'at the moment' — Present Continuous belgisi.
'ON the balcony' — balkon yuzasida → ON.

tasks.en: Paul: I'm enjoying the wonderful view.
tasks.note:
'a view' = manzara, ko'rinish.
'wonderful' = ajoyib.

tasks.en: Paul: Hey, have you got Jack's address?
tasks.uz: Pol: Ey, senda Jekning manzili bormi?
tasks.note:
'have got' savoli: HAVE + ega + GOT.
'Jack's address' — egalik apostrofi.

tasks.en: Ian: Yes, why?
tasks.note: Qisqa savol: 'Why (do you ask)?'

tasks.en: Paul: Because I want to send him a postcard.
tasks.uz: Pol: Chunki men unga otkritka jo'natmoqchiman.
tasks.note:
'Why' savoliga javob DOIM 'Because' bilan.
'want TO send' — 'want' dan keyin 'to + fe'l'.
'send somebody something' = kimgadir nimadir jo'natmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous — affirmative and negative.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous — tasdiq va inkor shakllari.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozirgi davomli zamon)

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
  I           AM     playing
  you         ARE    playing
  he/she/it   IS     playing
  we/you/they ARE    playing

INKOR (Negative):
  I           'M NOT  playing
  you         AREN'T  playing
  he/she/it   ISN'T   playing
  we/you/they AREN'T  playing

QOLIP: ega + to be + fe'l + ING

QACHON ISHLATILADI:
  HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun.

VAQT SO'ZLARI:
  now (hozir), at present (hozirda), at the moment (ayni paytda)

MISOLLAR:
  She's playing football now.
  She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.

O'ZBEKCHADA: '-yapti' qo'shimchasi bilan beriladi.
  She is playing → U o'ynayapti

tasks.en: Present Continuous — affirmative and negative.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous — tasdiq va inkor shakllari.

tasks.en: I am playing. / I'm not playing.
tasks.note: 'I' bilan faqat AM. Inkori: I'm not ('I amn't' YO'Q so'z).

tasks.en: You are playing. / You aren't playing.
tasks.note: 'you' — birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham ARE.

tasks.en: He is playing. / He isn't playing.
tasks.note: he/she/it → IS. Qisqartma: He's playing.

tasks.en: She is playing. / She isn't playing.
tasks.note: 'isn't' = is not.

tasks.en: It is playing. / It isn't playing.
We are playing. / We aren't playing.
tasks.note: we/you/they → ARE. 'aren't' = are not.

tasks.en: They are playing. / They aren't playing.
She's playing football now.
tasks.note: Kitobdagi namuna. 'now' — Present Continuous belgisi.

tasks.en: She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.
tasks.note: Kitobdagi namuna. 'at the moment' — Present Continuous belgisi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts in Ex. 7 again and fill in the -ing form of the verbs in the table below, then complete the rules.
exercises.instructionUz: 7-mashqdagi matnlarni qayta o'qing va quyidagi jadvalga fe'llarning -ing shaklini yozing, so'ng qoidalarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
-ING QO'SHISHNING UCH QOIDASI:

  1) KO'PCHILIK FE'LLAR — shunchaki -ing qo'shiladi
       snow → snowing,  wear → wearing,
       rain → raining,  enjoy → enjoying

  2) BITTA URG'ULI UNLI + BITTA UNDOSH bilan tugasa —
     UNDOSH IKKILANADI
       swim → swiMMing,  run → ruNNing,  sit → siTTing
     Sabab: unli qisqa qolishi kerak.

  3) -E bilan tugasa — E TUSHADI
       make → makIng,  decorate → decoratIng,
       shine → shinIng,  write → writIng

DIQQAT: 'enjoy' -y bilan tugasa ham -ing oddiy qo'shiladi
(y dan oldin UNLI bor: enjOY).

tasks.whyUz:
1-qoida: oddiy -ing qo'shiladi.

2-qoida: bitta urg'uli unli (i) + bitta undosh (m) → M IKKILANADI.
C otkritkada: 'Everyone is swimming'.

3-qoida: -E bilan tugaydi → E TUSHADI.
A va C otkritkalarda: 'making a snowman', 'making a sandcastle'.

exercises.instructionUz: Bu jadvaldagi qisqa javoblarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ SHAKLI (Interrogative):
  'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDIN chiqadi:
     Am I playing?    Are you playing?
     Is he playing?   Are they playing?

QISQA JAVOB QOIDASI:
  Yes, + ega + to'liq 'be' shakli.   (qisqartma YO'Q!)
  No,  + ega + qisqargan inkor shakli.

  TO'G'RI: Yes, I am.      XATO: Yes, I'm.
  TO'G'RI: No, I'm not.

JADVAL TO'LIQ HOLDA:
  Am I playing?      → Yes, I am.      / No, I'm not.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Is he playing?     → Yes, he is.     / No, he isn't.
  Is she playing?    → Yes, she is.    / No, she isn't.
  Is it playing?     → Yes, it is.     / No, it isn't.
  Are we playing?    → Yes, we are.    / No, we aren't.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Are they playing?  → Yes, they are.  / No, they aren't.

RASMDA PLYAJ MANZARASI:
  Ann   — qizil soyabon ostida gitara chalayapti
  Sue   — dengizda suzayapti
  Molly — dengizda suzayapti

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing) — affirmative, interrogative and negative.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous (to be + fe'l -ing) — tasdiq, so'roq va inkor shakllari.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — TO'LIQ JADVAL

  TASDIQ            SO'ROQ                 INKOR
  I'm playing       Am I playing?          I'm not playing
  you're playing    Are you playing?       you aren't playing
  he's playing      Is he playing?         he isn't playing
  she's playing     Is she playing?        she isn't playing
  it's playing      Is it playing?         it isn't playing
  we're playing     Are we playing?        we aren't playing
  you're playing    Are you playing?       you aren't playing
  they're playing   Are they playing?      they aren't playing

UCH SHAKLNI SOLISHTIRING:
  TASDIQ:  ega + be + fe'l-ing
  SO'ROQ:  be + ega + fe'l-ing?   ('be' oldinga chiqadi)
  INKOR:   ega + be + NOT + fe'l-ing

DIQQAT: barcha shakllarda ASOSIY FE'L o'zgarmaydi —
faqat 'to be' o'zgaradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Form, Use and Spelling of the Present Continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous yasalishi, ishlatilishi va imlosi.
exercises.explanationUz:
YASALISHI (Form):
  'to be' fe'li + asosiy fe'lning asos shakli + -ING

ISHLATILISHI (Use):
  1) HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish:
       I'm playing tennis now.
  2) Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA davom etayotgan ish:
       We're looking for a flat at the moment.
     (Aynan hozir qidirmayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin,
      lekin bu kunlarda shu ish davom etyapti.)

VAQT IFODALARI:
  now (hozir), at the moment (ayni paytda),
  at present (hozirda)

IMLO (Spelling) — UCH QOIDA:
  1) Ko'pchilik fe'l: shunchaki -ing → look - looking
  2) Ikki undosh ORASIDAGI bitta urg'uli unli bo'lsa,
     oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI → run - running
  3) -e bilan tugasa, -e TUSHADI → take - taking

tasks.en: Form, Use and Spelling of the Present Continuous.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous yasalishi, ishlatilishi va imlosi.

tasks.en: We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous 'to be' fe'li bilan yasaladi va asosiy fe'lning asos shakliga -ing qo'shiladi.
tasks.note: 'the base form' = asos shakl (lug'atdagi shakl).

tasks.en: We use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. — I'm playing tennis now.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous hozir, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ishlatiladi. — Men hozir tennis o'ynayapman.
tasks.note: Bu — asosiy vazifasi.

tasks.en: We also use the present continuous for actions happening around the time of speaking. — We're looking for a flat at the moment.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous gapirish payti atrofida davom etayotgan ish uchun ham ishlatiladi. — Biz ayni paytda kvartira qidiryapmiz.
tasks.note:
Aynan shu daqiqada qidirmayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin,
lekin bu davrda ish davom etyapti.

tasks.en: Time expressions used with the present continuous: now, at the moment, at present.
tasks.uz: Present Continuous bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ifodalari: now, at the moment, at present.
tasks.note: Bu so'zlar gapda ko'rinsa — Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: Most verbs take -ing after the base form of the main verb. — look - looking
tasks.uz: Ko'pchilik fe'llar asos shakldan keyin -ing oladi. — look - looking
tasks.note: 1-imlo qoidasi.

tasks.en: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and take -ing. — run - running
tasks.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugagan fe'llar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantiradi. — run - running
tasks.note:
2-imlo qoidasi: r-U-n → running.
Boshqa misollar: swim - swimming, sit - sitting, stop - stopping.

tasks.en: Verbs ending in -e drop the -e and take -ing. — take - taking
tasks.uz: -e bilan tugagan fe'llar -e ni tashlab -ing oladi. — take - taking
tasks.note:
3-imlo qoidasi.
Boshqa misollar: make - making, shine - shining, write - writing.

exercises.instructionEn: Short answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa javoblar.
exercises.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOBLAR JADVALI:

  Are you ...?   → Yes, I am.     / No, I'm not.
                   Yes, we are.   / No, we aren't.

  Is he/she/it ...? → Yes, he/she/it is.
                      No, he/she/it isn't.

  Are they ...?  → Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

QOIDA:
  Qisqa javobda 'Yes' yoki 'No', EGA OLMOSHI va
  'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shakli ishlatiladi.
  Asosiy fe'l (-ing bilan) TAKRORLANMAYDI.

  TO'G'RI: Is he playing? — Yes, he is.
  XATO:    Yes, he is playing.  (takrorlanmaydi)
  XATO:    Yes, he's.           (tasdiqda qisqartma yo'q)

DIQQAT — SAVOL 'YOU' BILAN BO'LSA:
  Javob 'I' yoki 'WE' bilan beriladi — kimga qaratilganiga qarab.

tasks.en: Short answers.
Are you playing? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
tasks.note: Bir kishiga qaratilgan savol → 'I' bilan javob.

tasks.en: Are you playing? — Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
tasks.note: Bir necha kishiga qaratilgan savol → 'we' bilan javob.

tasks.en: Is he playing? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
tasks.note: 'Yes, he's' XATO — tasdiq javobda qisqartma yo'q.

tasks.en: Is she playing? — Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Is it playing? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Are they playing? — Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
tasks.uz: Qisqa javobda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va 'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shakli ishlatiladi. Asosiy fe'l -ing bilan takrorlanmaydi.
tasks.note: 'a subject pronoun' = ega olmoshi (I, you, he, she, it, we, they).

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous vs Present Simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Continuous va Present Simple farqi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ZAMONNI SOLISHTIRISH — ENG MUHIM MAVZU

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS          PRESENT SIMPLE
  (be + fe'l-ing)             (fe'l / fe'l-s)

  HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan     ODAT va KUNDALIK tartib
  ish uchun:                  uchun:
    I'm studying now.           I go to work every day.

  Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA     DOIMIY holat uchun:
  davom etayotgan ish:          He lives in Manchester.
    He is working late
    these days.

VAQT SO'ZLARI BILAN FARQLASH:
  Present Continuous: now, at the moment, at present,
                      today, these days
  Present Simple:     every day, usually, always,
                      often, sometimes, never

MISOL — BIR FE'L, IKKI ZAMON:
  I'm studying now.        — hozir o'qiyapman (vaqtinchalik)
  I study every evening.   — har kuni kechqurun o'qiyman (odat)

SANDRANING UELSDAN YOZGAN XATI (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Dear Donna,
  I AM WRITING to you from Wales. I am on holiday with my
  family. We ARE VISITING my grandparents in a lovely village
  called St John's. We COME here every year.
  Sometimes it RAINS in March but this time the weather is
  beautiful and the sun IS SHINING.
  St John's is a very quiet place and it is nice to go for
  walks on the beach or have picnics in the countryside.
  This week we ARE very busy, because there is a special
  celebration on Saturday. The village is having a street
  party. Everyone IS WORKING very hard to decorate the streets
  and to build a stage for dancing and playing music. All the
  women ARE COOKING delicious food and ARE MAKING cakes.
  I AM HAVING a really good time.
  See you soon.
  Love, Sandra

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Donna,
  Men senga Uelsdan yozyapman. Oilam bilan ta'tildaman.
  Biz Sent-Jons degan go'zal qishloqda bobom-buvimnikiga
  mehmonga kelganmiz. Biz bu yerga har yili kelamiz.
  Ba'zan martda yomg'ir yog'adi, lekin bu safar ob-havo
  ajoyib va quyosh charaqlayapti.
  Sent-Jons juda tinch joy va plyajda sayr qilish yoki
  qishloqda piknik qilish yoqimli.
  Bu hafta biz juda bandmiz, chunki shanba kuni maxsus
  bayram bo'ladi. Qishloqda ko'cha bayrami o'tkazilyapti.
  Hamma ko'chalarni bezash va raqs hamda musiqa uchun
  sahna qurishga juda harakat qilyapti. Ayollarning hammasi
  mazali taom pishirayapti va tort tayyorlayapti. Men juda
  yaxshi vaqt o'tkazyapman.
  Tez orada ko'rishguncha. Mehr bilan, Sandra

     It's too small.  = U juda kichik (sig'maydi)

     It's VERY short. = U juda kalta (shunchaki fakt)
     It's TOO short.  = U haddan tashqari kalta (YOMON)

RASMDAGI SIFATLAR (TOO...):
  tight ...... tor, siqadigan
  short ...... kalta
  small ...... kichik
  expensive .. qimmat
  long ....... uzun
  big ........ katta

BERILGAN KIYIM SO'ZLARI:

  SA: What do you think of this skirt?
  SB: Well, I think it's too short.
  SA: What about these shoes?
  SB: Oh no! They're too expensive.

DIQQAT — BIRLIK va KO'PLIK:
  this skirt  → IT'S too short.
  these shoes → THEY'RE too expensive.

  4) Rang so'raydi
  5) O'lcham so'raydi
  6) Fikrini so'raydi

  Can I help you?          — Yordam bera olamanmi?
  I'm looking for ...      — Men ... qidiryapman
  What about ...?          — ... qanday bo'lar ekan?
  What do you think of ...? — ... haqida nima deysiz?
  What size is she?        — U qaysi o'lchamda?
  Here you are.            — Mana, oling.

'Can I help you?' = Yordam bera olamanmi?

Javobda 'dresses' aytilgan → savolda 'a nice dress' taklif qilingan.
'What about ...?' — taklif kiritish iborasi.
Javob RANG ('red') → 'What's her favourite colour?'

Javob O'LCHAM ('a twelve') → 'What size is she?'
Britaniyada ayollar kiyimi o'lchami: 8, 10, 12, 14 ...

sections.title: Writing (Project) — the seasons in my country

exercises.instructionEn: Write a short paragraph about the different seasons in your country. Write which is your favourite season and what you like doing then. Use the texts in Ex. 17 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: O'z mamlakatingizdagi turli fasllar haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing. Qaysi fasl sevimli ekanini va o'shanda nima qilishni yoqtirishingizni yozing. 17-mashqdagi matnlarni namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
17-MASHQ MATNLARI TUZILISHI (uchalasida ham bir xil):

  1) Mamlakat iqlimi haqida umumiy gap
  2) Har bir fasl haqida bir-ikki gap
  3) Sevimli fasl
  4) NIMA UCHUN (because ...)
  5) O'shanda nima qilishni yoqtirishi

FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  ... has a warm/cold climate.
  In winter it is ... / In summer it's ...
  It can be quite ...
  ... is my favourite season.
  I like ... the best because ...
  I love/like + fe'l-ING
  I often go for walks / go skiing / go swimming

tasks.en: Uzbekistan has a continental climate with four different seasons.
tasks.note:
'a continental climate' = kontinental iqlim.
Migelning matni ham shunday boshlanadi: 'Brazil has a warm climate.'

tasks.en: In winter it is cold and windy, and it sometimes snows.
tasks.note: 'it snows' — ob-havo fe'li, ega DOIM 'it'.

tasks.en: In spring it is warm and it often rains, so the trees are green and there are lots of flowers.
tasks.note: Karenning matnidagi iboralardan foydalanildi.

tasks.en: In summer it is very hot and sunny, and it hardly ever rains.
tasks.note: 'hardly ever' = deyarli hech qachon (chastota ravishi).

tasks.en: In autumn it is cool and quite rainy, but it is not very cold.
tasks.note: 'quite' = ancha (44-betdagi daraja so'zi).

tasks.en: Spring is my favourite season.
tasks.note: Migelning matnidagi qolip.

tasks.en: I like it the best because the weather is warm and everything is green.
tasks.note: Sabab DOIM 'because' bilan.

tasks.en: I love going for walks in the park and having picnics with my family.
tasks.note: 'love/like + fe'l-ING' — yoqtirish fe'llaridan keyin -ing.

tasks.en: Uzbekistan has a continental climate with four different seasons. In winter it is cold and windy, and it sometimes snows. In spring it is warm and it often rains, so the trees are green and there are lots of flowers. In summer it is very hot and sunny, and it hardly ever rains. In autumn it is cool and quite rainy, but it is not very cold. Spring is my favourite season. I like it the best because the weather is warm and everything is green. I love going for walks in the park and having picnics with my family.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below to write a postcard to a friend (40-60 words). Use the postcards in Ex. 7 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi reja bo'yicha do'stingizga otkritka yozing (40–60 so'z). 7-mashqdagi otkritkalarni namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  Dear + (do'stingizning ismi)
     Greetings from ...
     • Say where you are            — qayerda ekaningizni ayting
     • Say what the weather is like — ob-havo qandayligini ayting
     • Say what clothes you are wearing — nima kiyganingizni ayting
     • Say what you are doing now   — hozir nima qilayotganingizni ayting
     See you soon.
           Lots of love,
           (sizning ismingiz)

TALAB: 40–60 so'z.

NAMUNA: 49-betdagi uchta otkritka (Tom, Tracy, Pamela).

DIQQAT — BARCHA GAPLAR PRESENT CONTINUOUS'DA:
chunki HOZIRGI holat tasvirlanadi.
Faqat ob-havo sifat bilan aytilishi mumkin: 'It's very hot.'

tasks.en: Come rain or shine.
tasks.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Yomg'ir kelsin yoki quyosh chiqsin.

MA'NOSI: Ob-havo qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar;
har qanday sharoitda; nima bo'lsa ham.

ISHLATILISHI: va'da yoki qat'iyatni bildiradi.
  'I'll be there, come rain or shine.'
  = Nima bo'lsa ham, men u yerda bo'laman.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI: 'Har qanday holatda ham',
'Osmon uzilib tushsa ham'.

DIQQAT: 7-UNIT SARLAVHASI aynan shu maqol —
'Come Rain or Shine'.

tasks.en: March comes in like a lion and goes out like a lamb.
tasks.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Mart sherdek kirib keladi va qo'zichoqdek chiqib ketadi.

MA'NOSI: Mart oyining BOSHIDA ob-havo qattiq va shamolli
bo'ladi (sher kabi yovvoyi), OXIRIDA esa iliq va yumshoq
bo'ladi (qo'zichoq kabi muloyim).

Bu — Britaniyaning bahor ob-havosi haqidagi eski maqol.
Mart — qish va bahor chegarasi.

LUG'AT:
  a lamb /læm/ = qo'zichoq ('b' O'QILMAYDI)
  come in  = kirib kelmoq
  go out   = chiqib ketmoq
  like     = ...kabi, ...dek

O'ZBEKCHA O'XSHASHI: 'Mart — ola-quroq'.

tasks.en: Clothes make the man.
tasks.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Kiyim odamni yasaydi.

MA'NOSI: Odam qanday kiyinsa, shunday baholanadi;
kiyim odamning taassurotini belgilaydi.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI:
  'Ot ko'rki — yol, odam ko'rki — kiyim'
  'Kishini kiyimiga qarab kutib olishadi'

DIQQAT — GRAMMATIKA:
  'Clothes' — DOIM ko'plik → fe'l ham ko'plikda: MAKE.
  'Clothes makes the man' XATO.
  'a clothe' degan so'z YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in on or in.
exercises.instructionUz: on yoki in predloglarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT PREDLOGLARI — ON va IN

  ON — KUNLAR va SANALAR:
     on Sunday, on Monday morning,
     on 19th May, on my birthday,
     on Wednesday evenings (takrorlanadigan kunlar)

  IN — UZUNROQ DAVRLAR:
     in September (oylar)
     in 1974 (yillar)
     in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening
     in summer (fasllar)

  AT — ANIQ SOAT va istisnolar (bu mashqda yo'q):
     at 9 o'clock, at night, at the weekend

DIQQAT — CHALKASHTIRMANG:
  IN the morning     — umuman ertalab
  ON Monday morning  — aniq kunning ertalabi
  Kun aytilsa — ON g'olib chiqadi.

tasks.prompt: 1  Let's go to the cinema ............ Sunday.

Hafta kunlari oldida ON.
'Let's ...' = ...aylik (taklif).
tasks.speak: 1  Let's go to the cinema ............ Sunday.

tasks.whyUz:
Oy nomlari oldida IN.
'to start school' = o'qishni boshlamoq.

ANIQ SANA oldida ON: on 19th May.
DIQQAT: faqat yil bo'lsa IN bo'lardi: 'in 1974'.
Sana + oy bo'lsa — ON.
'to be born' = tug'ilmoq.

tasks.prompt: 4  Kevin goes to work ............ the morning.

'IN the morning/afternoon/evening' — umumiy kun qismi.
ISTISNO: 'AT night' (the yo'q, at bilan).
tasks.speak: 4  Kevin goes to work ............ the morning.

tasks.whyUz:
Hafta KUNI aytilgani uchun ON — 'in the evening' bo'lsa ham,
kun qo'shilsa ON g'olib chiqadi: ON Wednesday evenings.
Ko'plik ('evenings') — har chorshanba takrorlanishini bildiradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Dolphins ARE LIVING for about fifty years.  →  live
     (chizib tashlangan so'z o'rniga to'g'ri shakl yoziladi)

ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN XATO TURLARI:

  1) 3-SHAXS -S yo'q yoki ortiqcha:
       She often GO → GOES
       They VISITS → VISIT

  2) NOTO'G'RI ZAMON:
       Dolphins ARE LIVING (doimiy fakt) → LIVE
       John WEARS ... today (bugun) → IS WEARING

  3) 'BE' yoki 'HAVE GOT' shakli mos emas:
       Jane HAVE got → HAS got
       She ARE driving → IS driving
       These books ISN'T → AREN'T
       My brother HAVEN'T got → HASN'T got

tasks.prompt: 2  She often go to the beach on Sundays. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'She' — birlik 3-shaxs → fe'lga -ES kerak: GOES.
'often' → Present Simple to'g'ri tanlangan.
tasks.speak: 2  She often go to the beach on Sundays. → ............

tasks.whyUz:
'They' — ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI: VISIT.
-s faqat he/she/it uchun.

tasks.prompt: 4  This house cost £400 per month to rent. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'This house' — birlik 3-shaxs → COSTS.
'to cost' = turmoq (narx); 'per month' = oyiga; 'to rent' = ijaraga olmoq.
tasks.speak: 4  This house cost £400 per month to rent. → ............

tasks.prompt: 5  Every day, Paul catch the bus at 8 am. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'Paul' — birlik 3-shaxs → CATCHES (-ch → -ES).
'Every day' → Present Simple.
tasks.speak: 5  Every day, Paul catch the bus at 8 am. → ............

tasks.prompt: 6  Jane have got red hair and blue eyes. → ............
tasks.whyUz: 'Jane' — birlik 3-shaxs → HAS got ('have got' XATO).
tasks.speak: 6  Jane have got red hair and blue eyes. → ............

tasks.prompt: 7  I usually writes a letter to my friend every month. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'I' bilan fe'l ASOS shaklida — -S QO'SHILMAYDI: WRITE.
-s faqat he/she/it uchun.
tasks.speak: 7  I usually writes a letter to my friend every month. → ............

tasks.prompt: 8  She are driving to the beach now. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'She' — birlik → IS driving ('are' XATO).
'now' → Present Continuous to'g'ri tanlangan.
tasks.speak: 8  She are driving to the beach now. → ............

tasks.prompt: 9  John wears black trousers and a T-shirt today. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'today' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS kerak: IS WEARING.
'John wears ...' — odat bo'lardi, lekin 'today' hozirni bildiradi.
'trousers' = shim (doim ko'plikda).
tasks.speak: 9  John wears black trousers and a T-shirt today. → ............

tasks.prompt: 10  Every summer, we goes on holiday. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'we' — ko'plik → GO ('goes' XATO).
'go ON holiday' — 'on' predlogi shart.
tasks.speak: 10  Every summer, we goes on holiday. → ............

tasks.whyUz:
'These books' — ko'plik ega → AREN'T ('isn't' XATO).
'mine' = meniki (egalik olmoshi).

tasks.prompt: 12  My brother haven't got long hair. → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'My brother' — birlik 3-shaxs → HASN'T got ('haven't' XATO).
'hair' — sanalmaydigan ot, doim birlikda.
tasks.speak: 12  My brother haven't got long hair. → ............

'a biscuit' = pechenye; 'left' = qolgan.

Otsiz ishlatilgani uchun EGALIK OLMOSHI kerak → MINE.

ega yo'q, shuning uchun 'doesn't' XATO.

'Italian' UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → AN.

'some' — sanaladigan ot bilan KO'PLIK talab qiladi → DUCKS.
'ducks'' — egalik shakli, bu yerda kerak emas.

tasks.prompt: 15  ............ you like going to the cinema?
tasks.whyUz:
'you' + oddiy fe'l ('like') → DO.
'Are' XATO — 'like' fe'l, sifat emas.
'Does' faqat he/she/it uchun.

'at the moment' ham shuni tasdiqlaydi.

'is' + fe'l-ING → SHINING (-e TUSHDI).
'The sun shines' ham to'g'ri gap, lekin bu yerda 'is' bor.

EGALIK so'ralmoqda → WHOSE.
DIQQAT: 'Who's' = 'Who is' (kim) — boshqa ma'no,
lekin bir xil o'qiladi: /huːz/.

'... from?' — kelib chiqish JOYI so'ralmoqda → WHERE.
'Where are you from?' — o'zgarmas savol.

tasks.promptUz: Bog'da bir nechta olma daraxti bor.
