sentencePatterns.formula: What's the weather like (in + fasl/joy)? — It's + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the weather like in spring? — It's warm and sunny in spring.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bahorda ob-havo qanday bo'ladi? — Bahorda iliq va quyoshli bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bu — ob-havo haqidagi ASOSIY savol.
'like' bu yerda 'qanday?' degani, 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's + sifat (+ and + sifat).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's cold, cloudy and windy. It's freezing cold and snowy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sovuq, bulutli va shamolli. Qattiq sovuq va qorli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir necha sifat: vergul bilan, oxirgisidan oldin 'and'.
Ega DOIM 'it' — ob-havo haqida boshqa ega ishlatilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is raining/snowing.  —  It's a rainy/snowy day.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is raining. It's a rainy day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yomg'ir yog'yapti. Bugun yomg'irli kun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir xil ma'noni ikki xil aytish:
  FE'L bilan (-ing) yoki SIFAT bilan (-y).

sentencePatterns.formula: The sun is shining. / The wind is blowing. / There is a lot of fog.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Osmonda bulutlar bor va shamol esayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'sun', 'wind' — aniq ega bo'lgani uchun THE bilan.
'fog' sanalmaydi → 'a lot of fog' (ko'p tuman).

sentencePatterns.formula: someone IS WEARING + kiyim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is wearing a pink dress. He is wearing a black cap.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U pushti ko'ylak kiygan. U qora kepka kiygan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'wear' = kiyib turmoq (holat).
'put on' = kiyib olmoq (harakat).

sentencePatterns.formula: They are + fe'l-ING + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are sitting on the beach under a sunshade. They are walking by the lake.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular plyajda soyabon ostida o'tirishibdi. Ular ko'l bo'yida ketishayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Present Continuous — rasmdagi manzarani tasvirlash uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING (Present Continuous).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are making a snowman. It is snowing heavily.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular qorbobo yasashayapti. Qor qalin yog'yapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish.
Vaqt so'zlari: now, at the moment, today.

sentencePatterns.formula: someone IS WEARING + kiyim  /  someone IS IN + kiyim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The children are wearing their heavy jackets. The children are in their pyjamas.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bolalar qalin kurtka kiyib olishgan. Bolalar pijamada.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikki qolip ham bir xil ma'noda.
'be in' qolipi qisqaroq va tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ..., SO ... (sabab → natija).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is snowing heavily today, so the children are wearing their heavy jackets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun qor qalin yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar qalin kurtka kiyishgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' — NATIJA (shuning uchun).
'because' — SABAB (chunki). Tartibi teskari.

sentencePatterns.formula: ... AS ... (= because).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are very happy as they are decorating the Christmas tree.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular juda xursand, chunki archani bezashayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'as' bu yerda 'because' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can't imagine HOW + sifat + IT IS.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Varshavada qanchalik sovuq ekanini tasavvur qila olmaysiz!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bilvosita gapda so'z tartibi ODDIY qoladi:
'how cold IT IS' — 'how cold IS IT' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ism + is in + shahar. It's + ob-havo + there.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom is in Warsaw. It's very cold there and it is snowing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom Varshavada. U yerda juda sovuq va qor yog'yapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'there' = u yerda — shahar nomini takrorlamaslik uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING  (tasdiq)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's playing football now. They are making a snowman.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hozir futbol o'ynayapti. Ular qorbobo yasashayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'to be' egaga qarab o'zgaradi, fe'l esa doim -ING bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + 'm not / isn't / aren't + fe'l-ING  (inkor)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ayni paytda muzqaymoq yemayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Inkor 'be' fe'liga qo'shiladi, asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Am/Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING?  (savol)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he playing? Are they playing?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U o'ynayaptimi? Ular o'ynashayaptimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'li egadan OLDINGA chiqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Yes, + ega + be (TO'LIQ). / No, + ega + qisqargan inkor.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ha, o'ynayapti. / Yo'q, o'ynamayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq javobda qisqartma ISHLATILMAYDI: 'Yes, he's' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the temperature in + shahar? — It's + son + °C/°F.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the temperature in Cairo today? — It's 25°C. / It's 77°F.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun Qohirada harorat qancha? — 25 daraja.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'temperature' /ˈtemprətʃə/ — 'tempricha' deb o'qiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: When it is + ob-havo, you can + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When it is snowy you can ski or make a snowman.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qorli bo'lganda chang'i uchish yoki qorbobo yasash mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when' — vaqt bog'lovchisi.
'can' dan keyin fe'l asos shaklida.

sentencePatterns.formula: Wrong! X isn't/aren't + fe'l-ING. He's/She's/They're + to'g'ri fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Wrong! Patty isn't swimming. She's sunbathing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Noto'g'ri! Patti suzmayapti. U quyoshda toblanayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Avval inkor (ismi bilan), keyin to'g'ri javob (olmosh bilan).

sentencePatterns.formula: Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING? — No, ... isn't/aren't. + to'g'ri javob.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is Tony watching TV? — No, he isn't. He's playing tennis.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni televizor ko'ryaptimi? — Yo'q. U tennis o'ynayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa inkor javobdan keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot beriladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: In + fasl + it is / it's + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In summer it's nearly always hot and sunny.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yozda deyarli doim issiq va quyoshli bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fasl oldida IN. Ega DOIM 'it'.

sentencePatterns.formula: It can be + sifat (ehtimollik).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In autumn and spring it can be quite windy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kuz va bahorda ancha shamolli bo'lishi mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can be' — doim emas, ba'zan shunday bo'lishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is my favourite season. / I like X the best BECAUSE ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Summer is my favourite season. I like winter the best because there is always snow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yoz — sevimli faslim. Menga qish eng ko'p yoqadi, chunki doim qor bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Sabab DOIM 'because' bilan beriladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I love/like + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I love swimming and sunbathing at the beach.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men plyajda suzish va quyoshda toblanishni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: love, like, enjoy, hate fe'llaridan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: I often GO FOR walks / GO skiing / GO swimming.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I often go for walks in the park. I often go skiing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ko'pincha bog'da sayr qilaman. Ko'pincha chang'i uchgani boraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'go for a walk' — 'for' bilan.
'go skiing/swimming' — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri -ing bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ism + is wearing + kiyim1, kiyim2 and kiyim3.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paul is wearing a suit, a shirt and a tie.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pol kostyum, ko'ylak va galstuk kiygan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sanashda oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and', qolganida vergul.
BIRLIK kiyimda 'a' shart, KO'PLIKDA yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: What do you think OF + this/these + kiyim?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do you think of this skirt? What do you think of these shoes?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yubka haqida nima deysiz? Bu tuflilar haqida nima deysiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'think OF' — 'of' predlogi SHART.
Birlik → this;  ko'plik → these.

sentencePatterns.formula: Well, I think it's / they're TOO + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Well, I think it's too short. Oh no! They're too expensive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, u juda kalta. Voy yo'q! Ular juda qimmat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'too' — SALBIY baho beradi.
Birlik → IT'S;  ko'plik → THEY'RE.

sentencePatterns.formula: What about + this/these + kiyim?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What about these shoes?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu tuflilar-chi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'What about ...?' — mavzuni davom ettirish yoki taklif kiritish.

sentencePatterns.formula: material sifati + kiyim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a leather jacket, leather trousers, checked shorts, a long dress
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: charm kurtka, charm shim, katakli kalta shim, uzun ko'ylak
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Sifat DOIM otdan OLDIN turadi va o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: -ING bilan tugagan har qanday so'z → /ŋ/ tovushi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: wearing /ˈweərɪŋ/, making /ˈmeɪkɪŋ/, fishing /ˈfɪʃɪŋ/
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: kiyayotgan, yasayotgan, baliq ovi
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Til ORQASI tanglayga tegadi, til uchi hech narsaga tegmaydi.
Oxiridagi 'g' alohida O'QILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: X usually WEARS ... (odat)  ↔  X's WEARING ... today (hozir).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John usually wears jeans and T-shirts. John's wearing a suit and tie today.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon odatda jinsi shim va futbolka kiyadi. Jon bugun kostyum va galstuk kiygan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir odam, bir fe'l — ikki zamon.
Vaqt so'ziga qarang: usually → Simple;  today → Continuous.

sentencePatterns.formula: Look at + ism! He's/She's wearing + kiyim + today!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at Pam! She's wearing a dress today!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pamga qara! U bugun ko'ylak kiygan!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Hayrat bildirish qolipi. 'Look at ...!' bilan boshlanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She looks nice IN + kiyim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She looks nice in a dress!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unga ko'ylak juda yarashadi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'look nice IN' — 'in' predlogi SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I help you? — Yes, please. I'm looking for + kiyim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I help you? — Yes, please. I'm looking for a jumper.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Men jemper qidiryapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Do'kondagi standart boshlanish.

sentencePatterns.formula: What colour would you like? — rang.  Here you are.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What colour would you like? — Yellow. — Here you are.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz? — Sariq. — Mana, oling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'would like' — muloyim xohish shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I try IT on, please? — Yes, of course.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I try it on, please? — Yes, of course.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi? — Ha, albatta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Olmosh bilan 'try IT on' — 'try on it' XATO.
Ko'plik uchun: 'try THEM on'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Otkritka rejasi: Dear → Greetings from → joy, ob-havo, kiyim, mashg'ulot → See you soon → Lots of love.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dear Aziz, Greetings from Samarkand! It's very hot. I'm wearing a T-shirt and shorts. See you soon. Lots of love, Nilufar
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hurmatli Aziz, Samarqanddan salom! Juda issiq. Men futbolka va kalta shim kiyganman. Tez ko'rishguncha. Katta mehr bilan, Nilufar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 40–60 so'z. Barcha gaplar HOZIRGI holat haqida.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING.  (tasdiq)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is playing football. They are wearing heavy jackets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U futbol o'ynayapti. Ular qalin kurtka kiyib olishgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'to be' egaga qarab o'zgaradi, fe'l doim -ING bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + isn't/aren't/'m not + fe'l-ING.  (inkor)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He isn't playing football. I'm not going on a picnic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U futbol o'ynamayapti. Men piknikka bormayapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: NOT 'be' fe'liga qo'shiladi. Asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Am/Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING?  (so'roq)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he playing football? Am I going on a picnic?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U futbol o'ynayaptimi? Men piknikka boryapmanmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDINGA chiqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Yes/No + ega olmoshi + 'be' (asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he playing? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U o'ynayaptimi? — Ha. / Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Yes, he is playing' — asosiy fe'l keraksiz.
'Yes, he's' — tasdiqda qisqartma XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: Present Continuous (hozir) ↔ Present Simple (odat).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm studying now. / I go to work every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men hozir o'qiyapman. / Men har kuni ishga boraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Vaqt so'ziga qarang: now → Continuous; every day → Simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: Present Simple — doimiy holat uchun.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He lives in Manchester.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Manchesterda yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Doimiy holatda Continuous ISHLATILMAYDI.
'He is living in Manchester' — vaqtincha yashayotganini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + is/are + fe'l-ING + to'ldiruvchi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is wearing a hat. They are dancing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U shlyapa kiygan. Ular raqsga tushishayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Rasmdagi manzarani tasvirlash uchun asosiy qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: Yes/No + ega olmoshi + 'be'.  (asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he sleeping? — No, he isn't. Are they watching TV? — Yes, they are.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uxlayaptimi? — Yo'q. Ular televizor ko'rishayaptimi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiqda qisqartma YO'Q: 'Yes, he is' ('Yes, he's' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: Are YOU ...? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you listening to music? — Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Musiqa tinglayapsanmi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savol sizga qaratilgan → javobda 'I' (yoki 'we').

sentencePatterns.formula: usually/every ... + Present Simple  (he/she/it → fe'l + S)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jim usually wakes up late on Sundays. Joy watches TV every afternoon.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jim odatda yakshanba kunlari kech uyg'onadi. Joy har kuni tushdan keyin televizor ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odat va kundalik tartib → Present Simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: now / at the moment + Present Continuous
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We are making a snowman at the moment. The children are swimming now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz hozir qorbobo yasayapmiz. Bolalar hozir suzishayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish → Present Continuous.

sentencePatterns.formula: have a shower / have breakfast — HARAKAT, -ing mumkin.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bill is having a shower at the moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bill hozir dush qabul qilyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'have' EGALIK ma'nosida bo'lsa -ing OLMAYDI:
'I am having a car' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: usually / every ... + Present Simple
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It usually snows here this time of year. George drives to work every morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yilning bu paytida bu yerda odatda qor yog'adi. Jorj har kuni ertalab ishga mashinada boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Takrorlanadigan ish va odat → Present Simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: today / now / at the moment / this week + Present Continuous
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The sun is shining today. We are trying very hard this week.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun quyosh charaqlayapti. Bu hafta biz juda harakat qilyapmiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Hozir yoki shu davrda davom etayotgan ish → Present Continuous.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + isn't/aren't + fe'l-ING  (inkor)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My sister isn't swimming now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Singlim hozir suzmayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qavsda 'not' berilgan bo'lsa — inkor shakl kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: Everyone / everybody + IS + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Everyone is having fun and is enjoying the great weather!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hamma zavqlanayapti va ajoyib ob-havodan huzur qilyapti!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'everyone' grammatik jihatdan BIRLIK → IS.

sentencePatterns.formula: this + ot (birlik) → these + otlar (ko'plik);  that → those.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This boy loves football. → These boys love football.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu bola futbolni yaxshi ko'radi. → Bu bolalar futbolni yaxshi ko'rishadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ega ko'plikka aylansa, fe'ldan -s TUSHADI.

sentencePatterns.formula: 'be' fe'li -ING SHAKLIDA ISHLATILMAYDI.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am on holiday. My brother and I are very busy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ta'tildaman. Akam bilan men juda bandmiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'I am being on holiday' XATO — 'be' holat fe'li.

sentencePatterns.formula: This/That + ot (birlik) + is  →  These/Those + otlar + are.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: That car is expensive. → Those cars are expensive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Anavi mashina qimmat. → Anavi mashinalar qimmat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uch narsa birga o'zgaradi: olmosh, ot va fe'l.

sentencePatterns.formula: AT + soat  /  ON + kun, sana  /  IN + oy, yil, kun qismi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: at 9:00 am, on Sunday, on 19th May, in September, in the morning
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: ertalab soat 9 da, yakshanba kuni, 19-may kuni, sentabrda, ertalab
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Vaqt birligi qanchalik aniq bo'lsa, predlog shunchalik 'kichik':
AT (soat) < ON (kun) < IN (oy, yil).

sentencePatterns.formula: Kun + kun qismi bo'lsa → ON g'olib chiqadi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: in the evening  →  ON Wednesday evenings
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: kechqurun → chorshanba kunlari kechqurun
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'in the evening' — umumiy; kun qo'shilsa ON bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: egalik SIFATI + ot  /  egalik OLMOSHI (otsiz).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's my passport. → It's mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu mening pasportim. → Bu meniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ot bor bo'lsa — my/your/her. Ot yo'q bo'lsa — mine/yours/hers.

sentencePatterns.formula: DON'T + fe'l (buyruq gapning inkori).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't close the window.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Derazani yopma.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Buyruq gapda ega yo'q → 'doesn't' HECH QACHON ishlatilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Has/Have + ega + GOT + ot?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has James got a computer?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jeymsning kompyuteri bormi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'got' shakli o'zgarmaydi — faqat 'has/have' egaga moslashadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What is + ism + WEARING? — Ism + is wearing + kiyim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is Barry wearing? — Barry is wearing a T-shirt and shorts.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Berri nima kiygan? — Berri futbolka va kalta shim kiygan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'wear' = kiyib turmoq (holat).
Present Continuous — HOZIRGI holatni bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What is he/she DOING? — He/She is + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is he doing? — He is climbing a tree.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U nima qilayapti? — U daraxtga chiqayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'do' fe'li savolda, javobda esa aniq fe'l ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ikki kiyim: kiyim1 AND kiyim2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a T-shirt and shorts, a blouse and a skirt, a jean shirt and trousers
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: futbolka va kalta shim, bluzka va yubka, jinsi ko'ylak va shim
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
BIRLIK kiyimda 'a' shart: A blouse and A skirt.
KO'PLIK kiyimda 'a' YO'Q: shorts, trousers, jeans, trainers.

sentencePatterns.formula: listen TO + music (predlog shart).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is listening to music.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U musiqa tinglayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'listen music' XATO — 'to' predlogi tushib qolmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: We wear + kiyim + TO KEEP + ... warm.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We wear gloves to keep our hands warm.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz qo'limizni issiq saqlash uchun qo'lqop kiyamiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD.
'keep somebody/something warm' = issiq saqlamoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's + fe'l-ING.  ↔  It's a + sifat + day.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's snowing. It's a snowy day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qor yog'yapti. Qorli kun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bir hodisani ikki xil aytish. Sifat -Y bilan yasaladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: No, + olmosh + isn't/aren't + fe'l-ING. + To'g'ri javob.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, she isn't eating. She is drinking.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, u yemayapti. U ichayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval inkor, keyin to'g'ri ma'lumot.
Ism o'rniga OLMOSH ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Am/Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you cooking dinner? Is the dog sleeping in the garden?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqat pishiryapsizmi? It bog'da uxlayaptimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDINGA chiqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + is/are + ega + fe'l-ING?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is he doing at the moment?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ayni paytda nima qilayapti?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roq so'zi eng OLDINDA, keyin 'be', keyin ega.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ism + is wearing + kiyim.  He/She is + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ben is wearing a suit and tie. He is dancing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ben kostyum va galstuk kiygan. U raqsga tushayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ikki gap: birinchisi kiyim, ikkinchisi mashg'ulot haqida.

sentencePatterns.formula: ODAT (Present Simple)  ↔  HOZIR (Present Continuous)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Frank usually watches TV in the evenings. Is he watching TV now? — No, he isn't. He is working on a computer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Frenk odatda kechqurun televizor ko'radi. Hozir televizor ko'ryaptimi? — Yo'q. U kompyuterda ishlayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu qolip ikki zamon farqini eng aniq ko'rsatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: chastota ravishi + Present Simple  (never/often/usually).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bob never swims in the sea. Nick sometimes works long hours.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bob hech qachon dengizda suzmaydi. Nik ba'zan uzoq ishlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Chastota ravishi FE'LDAN OLDIN turadi ('be' dan keyin).

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + isn't/aren't + fe'l-ING  (inkor).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mother isn't cleaning the house. The dog isn't playing in the garden.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oyim uyni tozalamayapti. It bog'da o'ynamayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qavsda 'not' berilgan bo'lsa — inkor shakl kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: Be quiet! + The baby IS SLEEPING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jim bo'l! Chaqaloq uxlayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Buyruqdan keyin AYNI PAYTDAGI holat aytiladi → Present Continuous.

sentencePatterns.formula: What DO you DO in your free time?  (odat savoli)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do you do in your free time?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi 'do' — yordamchi, ikkinchisi — asosiy fe'l.
'What are you doing?' — HOZIR nima qilayotganini so'raydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: My sister and I = WE → fe'l ASOS shaklida.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My sister and I go to school every morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Singlim bilan men har kuni ertalab maktabga boramiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: '... and I' bilan tugagan ega DOIM ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I help you? — Yes, I'm looking for + mahsulot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I help you? — Yes, I'm looking for some pencils.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi? — Ha, men qalam qidiryapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'look FOR' = qidirmoq ('for' shart).
Tasdiq gapda SOME ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you have any ...? — Yes, of course.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you have any pencils? — Yes, of course.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sizda qalam bormi? — Ha, albatta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: SAVOLDA any, tasdiqda some.

sentencePatterns.formula: How many would you like? — Four please.  /  How much are they? — They're 50p each.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many would you like? — Four please. How much are they? — They're 50p each.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nechta xohlaysiz? — To'rtta. Ular qancha turadi? — Har biri 50 pens.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: HOW MANY — son (sanaladigan);  HOW MUCH — narx.

sentencePatterns.formula: What do you think OF + narsa? — It's lovely.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do you think of this T-shirt? — It's lovely.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu futbolka haqida nima deysiz? — Juda chiroyli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'think OF' — 'of' predlogi shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's + ism (telefonda o'zini tanishtirish).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hi Ian, it's Paul.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salom Ian, bu Pol.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Telefonda 'I am Paul' ISHLATILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: Otkritka: Dear ... → Greetings from ... → Present Continuous gaplar → See you soon → Love, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dear Jack, Greetings from Jamaica! I'm sitting on the balcony. See you soon. Love, Paul
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hurmatli Jek, Yamaykadan salom! Men balkonda o'tiribman. Tez ko'rishguncha. Mehr bilan, Pol
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Otkritkada HOZIRGI holat tasvirlanadi → Present Continuous.
